name: DRIP-R - A Dataset for Return policy Interpretation by LLM agents under Policy ambiguity
description: DRIP-R is a benchmark dataset for evaluating how LLM-based customer support agents handle policy ambiguities in return request scenarios. It combines an Amazon return policy with synthetic customer personas, ambiguity-grounded return tasks, and LLM-generated customer scenarios to enable systematic assessment of agent behavior under policy uncertainty. The dataset includes 400 scenario instances constructed by pairing 10 customer personas with 40 return tasks across three complexity levels (Medium, High, Very High), each scenario generating a realistic first customer message.
rai:dataCollection: The dataset was constructed via an LLM-assisted pipeline. The Amazon return policy was fetched via HTTP using automated scraping (trafilatura). Policy ambiguities were manually reviewed and catalogued. Customer personas were sampled from the PersonaHub dataset (Hugging Face) and structured into demographic and personality profiles using GPT-4.1. Return tasks were generated in batches by an LLM conditioned on policy ambiguities at three complexity levels. Scenarios were produced by pairing each persona with each task and prompting an LLM to generate a realistic first customer message.
rai:dataBiases: Policy coverage is limited to a single retailer (Amazon) return policy, which may not generalize to other e-commerce domains or policy styles.
Customer personas are synthetic, derived from the PersonaHub dataset, and do not represent the full diversity of real customer demographics.
Scenario narratives are LLM-generated (GPT-4.1) and reflect the model's priors about customer communication patterns.
rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking LLM-based customer support agents on their ability to interpret and resolve policy ambiguities in return requests.
Evaluating agent behavioral alignment, policy adherence, and resolution quality in simulated customer service dialogues.
Academic research on natural language understanding, policy comprehension, and multi-turn dialogue systems.
Not recommended for direct production deployment in customer service systems without independent validation on real-world data.
rai:dataLimitations: Covers a single retail domain (Amazon return policy); findings may not transfer to other policy types or domains.
Scenario diversity is constrained to 10 synthetic personas and 40 manually constructed task scenarios.
Customer interactions are entirely synthetic; behavioral realism has not been validated against real customer service logs.
Policy ambiguity taxonomy covers 8 types grounded in linguistics; other ambiguity dimensions (pragmatic, cultural) are not represented.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Persona records include synthetic demographic attributes: age range, gender, geographic location, income range, job sector, and personality traits (Big Five). All persona data is AI-generated and does not correspond to any real individual.
No real personally identifiable information (PII) is present in any component of this dataset.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Initial release: version 1.0.0. The dataset is released as a static research artifact accompanying the associated paper. No scheduled updates are planned. Bug reports and corrections may be submitted via the paper's contact information. Deprecated versions, if any, will be marked as such on the hosting platform (OSF).
rai:dataSocialImpact: This dataset supports research on the reliability and consistency of LLM-based agents in customer service settings, specifically in the presence of policy ambiguity. It can contribute to the development of safer and more transparent AI decision-making in commercial contexts. Potential risks include over-specialization of models to the Amazon return policy domain and the reinforcement of biases present in the underlying LLM (GPT-4.1) used for data generation.

distribution.name: personas.jsonl
distribution.description: Synthetic customer personas with demographic and personality attributes (10 personas).

distribution.name: policy_ambiguities_v3_final.csv
distribution.description: Manually catalogued ambiguities found in the Amazon return policy.

distribution.name: primary_policy.txt
distribution.description: Full text of the Amazon return policy (primary policy document).

distribution.name: related_policy_02.txt
distribution.description: Supplementary policy document covering returns to third-party sellers.

distribution.name: tasks.jsonl
distribution.description: Return task scenarios designed to test policy ambiguity interpretation, at three complexity levels (40 tasks: 34 unique stratified + 6 non-stratified extras).

distribution.name: scenarios.jsonl
distribution.description: Complete scenario instances (400 records, 10 personas x 40 tasks grid) combining policy, personas, tasks, and generated first customer messages.

recordSet.name: personas
recordSet.description: Synthetic customer personas used for scenario generation.

field.name: Name
field.description: Full name of the persona.

field.name: Age-range
field.description: Age bracket of the persona (e.g., 35-40).

field.name: Location
field.description: Geographic location of the persona.

field.name: Gender
field.description: Gender of the persona.

field.name: Job Sector
field.description: Professional sector of the persona.

field.name: Income range
field.description: Annual income range of the persona.

field.name: Person description
field.description: Narrative description of the persona's background and values.

field.name: Language Style
field.description: Communication register (e.g., Consultative, Terse, Verbose).

field.name: Personality Style
field.description: Big Five (OCEAN) personality trait scores as a serialized JSON object.

field.name: Communication style
field.description: Behavioral communication style (e.g., Direct, Confrontational, Rambling).

field.name: Persona_id
field.description: Unique identifier for the persona (format: Firstname_Sector_CountryCode_NN).

recordSet.name: policy_ambiguities
recordSet.description: Catalogued ambiguities in the Amazon return policy.

field.name: policy_clause
field.description: Exact quoted text from the return policy that contains the ambiguity.

field.name: Ambiguity_type
field.description: Classification of the ambiguity (e.g., Vagueness, Incompleteness, Coordination Ambiguity, Missing Condition, Semantic Ambiguity).

field.name: Ambiguity_description
field.description: Narrative explanation of why the clause is ambiguous.

field.name: List_of_ambiguities
field.description: Serialized list of specific ambiguous instances within the clause.

field.name: Intent
field.description: High-level summary of what the ambiguity highlights.

recordSet.name: return_tasks
recordSet.description: Return task scenarios grounded in policy ambiguities, at three complexity levels.

field.name: task_id
field.description: Unique identifier for the task (e.g., task_000, task_E01).

field.name: is_stratified
field.description: Whether this task is drawn from the stratified-35 task set (true) or is a non-stratified extra (false).

field.name: stratified_task_idx_aliases
field.description: List of original stratified task indices that point to this canonical task (typically a single value; multiple values indicate duplicates collapsed during deduplication).

field.name: detail
field.description: Detailed narrative description of the customer's return situation.

field.name: reason
field.description: Concise summary of the customer's concern or question.

field.name: task
field.description: One-sentence classification of the return type.

field.name: related_policy_issues
field.description: Serialized list of specific policy ambiguities relevant to this scenario.

field.name: complexity_level
field.description: Complexity level label: Medium, High, or Very High Complexity.

field.name: complexity_ordinal
field.description: Numeric complexity ordinal (3 = High, 4 = Very High).

field.name: primary_ambiguity_type
field.description: Primary ambiguity type targeted by this task.

field.name: all_ambiguity_types
field.description: Serialized list of all applicable ambiguity types for this task.

field.name: stratum_label
field.description: Combined stratification label (primary ambiguity type + complexity level, e.g., Coordination Ambiguity__High).

recordSet.name: scenarios
recordSet.description: Complete scenario instances combining policy, persona, task, and LLM-generated customer message. 400 records in JSONL format (10 personas x 40 tasks grid).

field.name: scenario_id
field.description: Unique scenario identifier (format: PersonaName_tTaskIndex_ScenarioIndex).

field.name: task_id
field.description: Identifier of the task underlying this scenario; links to the return_tasks record set.

field.name: source
field.description: Origin marker for the scenario record: '427' (present in the original 427-scenario submission) or '516_extra' (drawn from the 516-scenario superset to fill grid cells absent from 427).

field.name: first_customer_message
field.description: LLM-generated opening message from the customer, grounded in the task and persona.

field.name: detail_agent
field.description: Brief agent-perspective interpretation of the customer's request.

field.name: persona_name
field.description: Name of the customer persona for this scenario.

field.name: persona_age_range
field.description: Age range of the customer persona.

field.name: persona_location
field.description: Geographic location of the customer persona.

field.name: persona_gender
field.description: Gender of the customer persona.

field.name: persona_job_sector
field.description: Professional sector of the customer persona.

field.name: persona_language_style
field.description: Language register of the customer persona.

field.name: persona_communication_style
field.description: Behavioral communication style of the customer persona.

field.name: persona_id
field.description: Unique identifier of the customer persona; links to the personas record set.

field.name: task_detail
field.description: Detailed return task narrative.

field.name: task_reason
field.description: Concise summary of the return task.

field.name: task_complexity_level
field.description: Complexity level of the task (Medium, High, or Very High Complexity).

field.name: task_primary_ambiguity_type
field.description: Primary ambiguity type targeted by the task.

field.name: customer_basic_info
field.description: Factual purchase and product details known to the customer.

field.name: customer_private_info
field.description: Information the customer withholds or does not immediately disclose to the agent.

field.name: customer_behavior
field.description: Description of the customer's strategic communication behavior during the interaction.
